reason: Not this month. I don't sign up for something students will rely on because the idea is nice. Nobody has told me which colleges already use it, and a small startup asking for access to our Microsoft 365 and ERP will take IT and the management weeks to clear. I might agree to the free pilot after I've spoken to a college that runs it, but I wouldn't commit ₹9 lakh before that.
objection: Who else uses this? I want to call a dean at a college like ours and hear whether it really pulls from our existing systems or whether my staff end up entering every notice a second time when the integration breaks.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three comparable Indian colleges I can phone, with their before-and-after numbers on missed submissions, and IT confirming the M365 connection works without any extra posting by staff.
